title: Redstrike Source Context
description: White-box pre-analysis emitted by the source-audit feeder: dangerous-sink candidates (file:line) mapped to a vuln class and routed to the executor that proves them, plus secret + dependency candidates. A candidate is a LEAD, not a finding — static only, no runtime proof here.

candidates.description: dangerous-sink leads routed to executors; proven by the executor against the running target

taint.description: reachability from the semgrep mode:taint pass. Present only when a taint rule evaluated this sink: reachable=true means attacker input provably reaches the sink unsanitized (high confidence) — a sink that grep found but taint did NOT reach is present-but-unproven (downgrade). A candidate is still a LEAD the routed executor proves live.

reachable.description: attacker source flows to the sink without a sanitizer

source.description: matched taint source, e.g. $_GET / request.args / req.query

sanitized.description: true if a sanitizer broke the flow (candidate dropped or downgraded)

rule_id.description: the taint rule that matched, e.g. php-taint-command-injection

secret_candidates.description: hardcoded-secret leads → secrets skill; the VALUE is never stored here, only a fingerprint

structural.description: D2 — structural facts the chain reasoner composes over: route handlers, auth guards (present/absent), object-id reads, mass-assignment, writable/web-exec paths. An authz absence (missing-ownership-check / unauth-route) is asserted by the reasoner after confirming the handler has no check — semgrep flags the candidate, the reasoner confirms the negative. A fact is context, not a finding.

method.description: HTTP method when kind is a route, e.g. POST

route_path.description: the URL path the route binds, when known

source.description: semgrep = extractor-found; manual = reasoner-asserted (e.g. a confirmed absence)

chain_candidates.description: D2 — CANDIDATE attack chains composed at the source level from taint-reachable sinks + structural facts, per a pattern in refs/chains/. Routed as an ORDERED executor sequence that proves the chain live. Still a LEAD, never a finding: source-audit is a feeder. Differs from attack-chain-discovery, which composes ALREADY-ACCEPTED findings post-proof — these are pre-proof source hypotheses.

pattern.description: the catalog pattern id from refs/chains/, e.g. lfi-log-poison-rce / unauth-state-change

kind.description: technical = taint/dataflow chain; logic = authz/business-logic chain (no tainted-data signature)

steps.description: ordered chain steps; each references a candidate id (sa-NNN) or structural fact id (sf-NNN)

ref.description: candidate id (sa-NNN) or structural fact id (sf-NNN) this step rests on

note.description: what this step contributes / the precondition it satisfies

route_sequence.description: ordered executors that PROVE the chain, each confirming the next's precondition

preconditions.description: code conditions the chain assumes; mark which the reasoner confirmed vs assumed

confidence.description: lead quality: high = every step taint-reachable/confirmed; low = an inferred/assumed link

routing.description: executor hints the candidate map warrants
